roots.description:
치타 Agent Hub 산출물(아웃풋) 뷰어 패널.
- title: 파일/산출물 이름
- type: 파일 형식 (MD, PDF 등), show type으로 점·형식 표시 토글
- show expand / show close: 우측 icon-button 노출
- content: 본문 슬롯 — 미리보기 콘텐츠를 자유롭게 배치
패널 높이는 인스턴스에서 리사이즈하면 content가 채워짐.

observations.note: One standalone COMPONENT, not a variant set. Six properties: title/type TEXT, show type/show expand/show close BOOLEAN defaulttrue, content SLOT with empty preferredValues. Only the supplied all-visible Light layout with empty native SLOT was rendered.

Two actual ghost/default/24 IconButton source2427:25108, radius4, no rendered border/fill, glyph16 at4,4. Actions52x24 absolute at483,5 (5px outer right inset; border-relative CSS right4) gap4. show expand and show close control independent visibility, not expanded/open state.

Actual expand glyph is icon/maximize/16 source3015:24201, actual close glyph is icon/x/16 source2311:46284, both16px/stroke1/#1C1C1C. Both instance names/generated asset constants misleadingly say icon/plus/24. Use source identity and exact supplied assets, not those labels.

Actual child3015:24236 is native SLOT, not FRAME or INSTANCE, bound slotContentId content#3015:5; children[]. Geometry540x943 at0,34, FILL both axes/layoutGrow1, px8/py16/gap24, white, bottom corners16 only; border top0/bottom-left-right1#DDD included. Interior capacity522x910 before child content. Header bottom border is the single seam; do not add a second top border.

Description explicitly supports resized instances with content filling remaining height. No drag handle or interactive resize implementation is provided. Height977/width540 are samples, not minimum/max/fixed product viewport constraints. Content clips true with overflowDirection NONE; clipping is not working scroll.

Product owner connects expand/close intent, output identity/revision and content loading/renderer. No expanded render, browser Fullscreen API, modal/scrim, tabs, download/copy/edit toolbar, PDF/Markdown/HTML decoder or loading/error/empty UI contract appears in this node. Proposed product behavior must be labelled and verified separately.

Static Light reference only, allStatesVerified/runtimeVerified false. Boolean false branches have property bindings but no separately rendered permutations. No dark/mobile/long-content/focus/disabled/animation/network or consuming source/export has been verified. Common bundle remains optional and only selected Agent Hub catalog adopts this contract.

Read-only follow-up inspection found empty reactions arrays on all18 nodes supporting ReactionMixin, including expand/close controls and their glyphs. Native SLOT has no reactions member. This source does not specify a prototype destination/action or animation for these controls.
